"""App: two INTERNAL imports and no external one."""

from pkg.engine import Engine
from pkg.wheel import Wheel


def build(ceiling: int) -> int:
    """Build."""
    engine = Engine(ceiling)
    wheel = Wheel(ceiling)
    total = engine.spin(ceiling)
    if total > 3:
        total -= wheel.ceiling
    else:
        total += wheel.ceiling
    return total
